source.title: Xiaomi CyberGear micromotor instruction manual (English translation, belovictor/cybergear-docs)
source.locator: Section 1.3.15, maximum overload time vs torque

notes: Vendor overload table at 24 rpm and 25 C ambient; each row ends when the winding reaches 120 C. The table marks 4 Nm as rated, with no time. The test voltage is not stated for this table (24 V is the rated voltage). The starting winding temperature is not stated, so the rise is not recorded. The same manual sets the board limit at 80 C and the default CAN motor warning and fault at 75 and 80 C, below the 120 C endpoint. The Chinese original is mirrored at roboticscv.com, whose TLS certificate does not validate.
